findings.highlight: The two sisters leave the dojo and enter the yard.
findings.evidenceJa: 二人を道場に残して中庭に出る。
findings.governingReading: Rin leaves Shirou and Illya inside; Sakura is already outside and is refused entry3.
findings.explanation: Leaving two in the dojo becomes two sisters leaving it.

findings.highlight: She knows full well how insecure and gloomy Sakura is
findings.evidenceJa: 間桐桜が背負った不安と負い目を知った上で
findings.governingReading: 負い目 is guilt/indebtedness, paired with anxiety; Rin knows this psychological disadvantage as she pressures her.
findings.explanation: Knowing Sakura’s burden of guilt becomes knowing she is gloomy.

findings.highlight: she's constantly on guard against Zouken's next move.
findings.evidenceJa: 姉はいつ自分が間桐臓硯の手に落ちて敵に回るかを危惧している。
findings.governingReading: Rin fears when Sakura will fall into his hands and become an enemy;6 repeats Sakura’s susceptibility.
findings.explanation: Fear Sakura falls under Zouken’s control becomes general vigilance toward Zouken.

findings.highlight: What are you going make Senpai do?
findings.evidenceJa: 姉さんは先輩に何をさせる気なんですか。
findings.governingReading: Sakura asks what Rin intends to make him do.

findings.highlight: to do even more things to him
findings.evidenceJa: これ以上なにをさせようって言うんです
findings.governingReading: なにをさせよう asks what further action Rin will make him perform.
findings.explanation: Making Shirou do more becomes doing more to him.

findings.highlight: he's already been taking the shroud off, even though I haven't told him to.
findings.evidenceJa: わたしが言わなくても、あいつは自分から聖骸布を外してたわ。
findings.governingReading: Rin realizes he would remove it on his own even without her instruction; きっと最後には predicts the eventual act. Earlier00–03 establishes a test and limited loosening, not full removal.
findings.explanation: Predicted eventual cloth removal becomes repeated completed removal.

findings.highlight: Once you realize that your method can't defeat Grandfather
findings.evidenceJa: もし今の方法でお爺さまを倒せないと判れば
findings.governingReading: もし determines whether the present method proves unable to defeat Zouken.
findings.explanation: If failure is discovered becomes once failure is discovered.

findings.highlight: It's the obvious choice to make, since all it will cost is his life.
findings.evidenceJa: 彼一人の命で済むのなら当然でしょう
findings.governingReading: 彼一人の命で済むのなら conditions her sacrifice justification on his sole life being sufficient.
findings.explanation: If one life suffices becomes since his life is the entire cost.

findings.highlight: nor do I have the right to order him around.
findings.evidenceJa: そもそも本当なら士郎に発言権はないの。
findings.governingReading: 士郎に発言権はない denies his say, preceding her ownership assertion.
findings.explanation: Shirou has no right to speak becomes Rin has no right to order him.

findings.highlight: I want him to fight, so I'll borrow his power as much as I need to.
findings.evidenceJa: わたしはあいつが戦いを望む以上、全力で力を貸すし、貸してもらうだけなんだから
findings.governingReading: He desires battle, so she lends all her help and receives his; both directions are explicit.
findings.explanation: Supporting his wish and borrowing reciprocally becomes wanting him to fight and borrowing.
